title: [Podcast] Move The Cognitive Stack into its dedicated repository
summary: Move podcast assets into the verified private dedicated repository with exact provenance; remove ADL originals only after verified push.
non_goals_inline: No deployment, provider calls, audio generation, unrelated source retirement or history rewrite.
dependencies_inline: Private destination created; source main clean; native issue1285 reconciled; bounded FastWork space available.
repo_inputs_inline: Podcast asset trees, tools, production packages, planning notes, repository map and active consumers inventoried by Planning12.
target_files_surfaces_inline: demos/podcast; demos/_preview/podcast; podcast tools and examples; active references; docs/REPOSITORIES.md; tools/podcast_migration.
deliverables_inline: Private committed/pushed source snapshot; hash/mode manifest and source revision mapping; unpublished material labels; ADL relocation pointers and active consumer cleanup.
validation_plan_inline: Deterministic bounded node:test migration/reference checks, exact exported hash and RSS identity verification, offline fixture checks, independent review, native proof and required CI.
acceptance_criteria_inline: All scoped assets preserved and verified remotely before original removal; published URLs/GUIDs unchanged; no broken live ADL references; reviewed PR closes1285.
notes_risks_inline: Historical records stay immutable. Shared provider adapter may stay in ADL. Legacy pipeline requires installed ADL runtime and is not production-qualified by migration. Limited disk space precludes unrelated history clone.
